falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it proves this is not a repeat of that bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/early capitulation; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than bottoming behavior, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal which assumes no immediate systemic stress event

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by >25bps from current level (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion signals accelerating recession pricing that contradicts a bottom formation; the August 2024 bottom occurred during yield curve steepening, so further inversion proves this macro regime differs fundamentally from the matched pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
